document: R480 EVIDENCE AND PERMISSION DECISION MATRIX
source_scope: Public vendor descriptions, accessible experimental abstracts, FTC guidance and account-specific pending email. No completed purchase, actual product use or contract acceptance.

claims.claim: Zen12 seller describes twelve-minute sessions
claims.decision: May describe as seller-specified, not independently validated quality/benefit

claims.claim: Zen12 seller describes twelve progressive levels
claims.decision: May state the seller's listed format, verify actual order SKU

claims.claim: Zen12 seller describes four styles: guided/music/noise/nature
claims.decision: May state seller-described modalities, not production quality

claims.claim: Zen12 seller displays MP3/downloadable program
claims.decision: May describe as seller listed, not verify delivery entitlement

claims.claim: 12 minutes equals one hour of meditation
claims.decision: Do not endorse; requires product-specific direct comparative support

claims.claim: The audio automatically shifts brainwaves into relaxation
claims.decision: Do not endorse; mechanism unverified for Zen12

claims.claim: Zen12 eliminates stress/anxiety or mental-health symptoms
claims.decision: Do not repeat as proven; FTC health substantiation required

claims.claim: An individual session guarantees immediate benefit
claims.decision: Do not repeat as FV promise

claims.claim: Brainwave entrainment is proven for every listener
claims.decision: Do not endorse; 2023 review is inconsistent and product nonspecific

claims.claim: Secret promotional page shows a discounted coupon/countdown
claims.decision: Can note page differs from standard in internal matrix; never import countdown, price or code into FV presell

claims.claim: Promotional bundle and seller guarantee apply to FV referrals
claims.decision: Not authenticated for Final Vestige SKU/checkout; no guarantee/price claim

claims.claim: Named FV Inspire3 account accepted
claims.decision: Aug 24 pending notice is not acceptance; require affirmative named proof

claims.claim: Website, video/social and email promotional channels allowed
claims.decision: Require specific written partner channel terms; email is separate permission

claims.claim: Current authorized tracking URL and exact SKU issued
claims.decision: No link may be generated/guessed/published

claims.claim: Commission rate/payout/refund settlement confirmed
claims.decision: No commission or net revenue inferred from outbound clicks

claims.claim: 2023 review of fourteen binaural EEG studies reports inconsistent outcomes
claims.decision: May report review methodology/results with heterogeneity and scope

claims.claim: 2023 review establishes clinical benefit for Zen12 specifically
claims.decision: Not a Zen12 trial; prohibited

claims.claim: Pendulum movement can be influenced by feedback, attention and expectations
claims.decision: May describe experimental findings; no products or supernatural claim follow

claims.claim: 1976 experiment included 60 college students
claims.decision: May report sample and limitations

claims.claim: Puységur archive independently proves animal magnetism cures
claims.decision: False inference from notarization/testimony; prohibit

claims.claim: Existing Focus Fieldbook is an ungated free paid product
claims.decision: Existing 52-page fieldbook is free with established email opt-in; not a checkout SKU

claims.claim: An affiliate disclosure only on generic site disclosure page is sufficient
claims.decision: Use conspicuous near-link disclosure; no standalone generic-page-only reliance

claims.claim: Affiliate outbound click is a confirmed sale
claims.decision: Clicks are diagnostic and never equal paid settlements

claims.claim: No authenticated FV-owned payable Mind SKU was identified in this audit
claims.decision: Report as not authenticated, not proof that none exists

owned_product_fallback.note: Do not re-label free Focus Fieldbook as a paid product.
